استعذوا (form X)
# اِسْتَعْذَوْا (istaʕḏaw) /is.taʕ.ðaw/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَعْذَى (istaʕḏā)
# اُسْتُعْذُوا (ustuʕḏū) /us.tuʕ.ðuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَعْذَى (istaʕḏā)
# اِسْتَعْذُوا (istaʕḏū) /is.taʕ.ðuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَعْذَى (istaʕḏā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
